# semaphore_ex_project_notification_routing_preview (Ephemeral Resource)

Evaluates notification routing without sending a notification. Opening this ephemeral resource evaluates the preview; results are not persisted in Terraform state. LDAP/OIDC previews record server-side reconciliation history. No automatic apply, renewal or deletion of audit history is performed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
ephemeral "semaphore_ex_project_notification_routing_preview" "example" {
  project_id = 1
  event = {
    source_revision  = 1
    source           = { kind = "task", id = "task:12" }
    lifecycle_id     = "template:7"
    severity         = "error"
    lifecycle_action = "trigger"
    details          = { task_id = 12, template_id = 7, status = "failed" }
  }
}

# Reference ephemeral.semaphore_ex_project_notification_routing_preview.example.result in an ephemeral context.
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `event` (Dynamic) Native NotificationEvent object. Scope and project identity are derived from this operation and cannot be changed by the event.
- `project_id` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `result` (Dynamic, Sensitive) Complete native result, excluding any preview token. It is ephemeral and never stored in Terraform state. Sensitive because results may describe identity or execution metadata.
